product_overview: A Laravel-based backend for church staff and public-facing configuration data. It provides secure session authentication for panel users, a public settings snapshot, and a lightweight health endpoint to verify application and database availability.
core_goals: Provide secure staff login with CSRF-protected session authentication
Expose authenticated user identity for the panel
Serve a public snapshot of church settings without leaking restricted notification recipient data
Offer an unauthenticated health check that confirms the app and database are responding

features.name: Health check
features.description: Allows monitoring systems to confirm the application and database are healthy and to identify the active release id.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with {status: ok, release: <id>} when the application and database respond
GET /api/health -> Receive 503 with {status: error} when the application or database does not respond

features.name: Staff authentication
features.description: Supports CSRF-protected session login for staff users and retrieval of the currently authenticated account.
user_flows: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie -> Receive 204 and set XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies -> POST /api/auth/login with valid email/password and X-XSRF-TOKEN header -> Receive 200 with user roles and permissions -> GET /api/auth/me with session cookie -> Receive 200 with authenticated user
GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie -> Receive 204 and set XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies -> POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 422 validation error
POST /api/auth/login without obtaining CSRF cookie or without valid X-XSRF-TOKEN header -> Receive authentication failure or validation error
GET /api/auth/me without authenticated session -> Receive 401 unauthenticated

features.name: Public settings
features.description: Returns a public snapshot of church settings such as schedule, address, WhatsApp, and YouTube without exposing notification recipient data.
user_flows: GET /api/public/settings -> Receive 200 with public settings including schedule, address, WhatsApp, and YouTube -> Confirm notification_recipients is not present in the response
GET /api/public/settings -> Receive 200 with public settings payload that excludes restricted fields
GET /api/public/settings when the endpoint is unavailable or fails -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Health check
features.description: Phase 10 added only Artisan commands and scheduled tasks (encrypted database backup, copy to Backblaze B2, retention purge, daily report, mail failure check, release cleanup). The reduced check proves the application and the database still answer after the scheduler was completed

endpoints.description: Returns 200 with status ok and the active release id when the application and the database respond; 503 otherwise. No internal data
